# awscc_healthagent_domain (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::HealthAgent::Domain. Creates and manages a HealthAgent Domain resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Domain.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags associated with the Domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Domain.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the Domain was created.
- `domain_id` (String) The unique identifier of the Domain.
- `encryption_context` (Attributes) Encryption context for the Domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--encryption_context))
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the Domain.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--encryption_context"></a>
### Nested Schema for `encryption_context`

Read-Only:

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_healthagent_domain.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Domain

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_healthagent_domain.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_healthagent_domain.example "arn"
```
